<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court halts Andhra elections:</strong> The Supreme Court has intervened in Andhra Pradesh, prompting the State Election Commission to halt the election process for 100 urban local bodies, a move the YSRCP has framed as a significant rebuke to the Naidu government.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPYWRSTTF4dVc0OXBiemhNOElyU2Q0QzZuSHhxWjROZUJjdjhCeXYtbFJuWnd5YTd2Rmh4MGV4MmsyWFZvYUlhYTNINTRMQVl2cFBtY0pMRi12OU1oSDhUYjltZW5Odl83cmpfd3ZLV0piWGxneUswN3M2d2kzWHdrMDFsb0FES2JPTGxVMjZmX1NhdVRSN1dlUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>INDIA bloc mobilizes:</strong> The opposition INDIA bloc is convening an online meeting to finalize plans for nationwide &quot;vote chori&quot; protests and a major rally scheduled for November 1.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Diplomatic representation:</strong> Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is set to represent India at the upcoming Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) heads of government meeting in Tajikistan.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxQd2s0Q3ZzeVJSMFU1dkhQcXUxQm1obEVMYlRIRl93clBTZmZtYWlrNEtkeVNuNDNVbk54ZG1vTUNkNExZMHlPdkZXaVJiUGZ1Mlg0dkZBWlpPcmRmaTVaZXlSLWJ4SDF6YzgzVnItRHJud0NRNjRHSmdMWFdwVmh0b21ZQkZ4WG5xSDE3N1pYUFIyOVVIREJzaTlPQjRJNFdObmhGVjFfZUh6b0I4Y2wtTVVLYmRvQUt3MEs4QlltQjByUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition protest strategy:</strong> The INDIA bloc is coordinating its national policy on addressing alleged electoral irregularities, focusing on upcoming protest actions and a November 1 rally.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political rhetoric on protests:</strong> Former BJP leader Annamalai has invoked Prime Minister Modi’s 2011 remarks regarding a &quot;war against the Centre&quot; to defend his stance on current CJP protesters.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-CA&amp;gl=CA&amp;ceid=CA%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
